pick.name: Pixabay Music
pick.why: Free, no attribution, usable in commercial videos anywhere (not just YouTube).
pick.free_limits: Free; no standalone resale; Content ID behaviour per track not stated

alts.free_limits: 10,000 Flow Music credits/month on AI Pro; commercial terms unverified

decision: Pixabay is the only option with a clear free commercial licence for use on any platform. Use Flow Music for bespoke tracks once Google's commercial terms for generated music are confirmed.

verify.note: Licence page silent on Content ID, as stated. Flow Music 10,000 credits/mo on AI Pro confirmed on Google's AI plans page.
